messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "do not assume medicine is to blame"
set: ["do not assume medicine is to blame", "do not inject leftover medicine", "do not keep leftover medicine", "do not allow the liquid medicine to freeze", "do not float a medicine canister in water to see if it is empty", "do not sell or give away medicine", "do not take more medicine without talking to healthcare provider", "do not breast-feed while taking this medicine", "do not transfer leftover medicine into syringe", "do not double up if dose is not controlling symptoms", "after medicine is stopped", "tests to determine if medicine is effective", "do not use anti-diarrhea medicine unless doctor instructs", "do not share this medicine with anyone else", "do not divide the medicine in the capsule", "do not take to lose weight"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
